notes:
Environmental sound pressure level measurement recorded continuously for approximately one hour in the open-plan office of a large financial institution in London.

The measurement captures the typical acoustic environment experienced during everyday office work, including conversations, telephone and video calls, movement through the workspace, keyboards and office equipment, ventilation systems, and the cumulative background sound generated by a large number of people sharing an open space.

Unlike measurements dominated by individual high-level events, this recording is intended to document sustained everyday workplace noise exposure. The one-hour duration captures both quieter periods and temporary increases in activity, providing a more representative picture of the changing sound environment experienced by someone working in the space.

The measurement forms part of the SPL Reference real-world environmental dataset, providing a reference for comparison with other workplaces, public spaces, transport environments, domestic settings, and urban locations.
